Might & Magic Fates is an original strategy card game rooted in the legendary Might & Magic universe. Build your deck, summon mythical creatures, cast devastating spells, and lead iconic heroes into battle. Each card is part of a living legacy shaped by decades of fantasy lore and player imagination.   

Learn more at www.MightAndMagicFates.com
